sources.title: gervasio-70b-portuguese-ptpt-decoder - Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Acknowledgments This is the model card for Gervásio 70B PTPT Decoder. This model is integrated in the Evaristo.ai chatbot, where its generative capabilities can be experimented with on the fly through a GUI. You may be interested in some of the other models in the Albertina (encoders), Gervásio (decoders) and Serafim (sentence encoder) families.
